$comment: Producer-owned immutable coordinates for verified module publications. Rows are appended mechanically by the release recorder from the annotated tag and the exact build-once wheel carried into registry verification; source changes never predict future release hashes. Every row carries a verification_run_id and is proven against its annotated tag's ModuleReleaseTagEvidence.v1 message (rendered/parsed by scripts/write_release_record.py), never trusted from the row alone.
